reference_policy: The completed initial SwarmGo reference from the interrupted extension and final trial 13 check drift. They remain separate and are not added to the existing six-run primary median.
primary_policy: Use all valid planned observations. Never exclude a run because its RPS is low or high.
invalidity_policy: A failed full observation, invalid target counters, or changed binary/workload settings invalidates its predeclared pair. Retain the records; stop to inspect instead of silently replacing runs.
